metadata.title: Pluricanonical locally conformally almost Kähler metrics, circle-invariant $G_2$ structures, and Laplacian flows
metadata.abstract: We study explicit Hodge evolutions of pluricanonical locally conformally almost Kähler metrics and their relation to locally conformal parallel $G_2$ structures. A compact locally conformal parallel $7$-manifold with a parallel non-zero Lee form, carrying a structure-preserving free circle action of constant orbit length orthogonal to the Lee field, has a $6$-dimensional quotient which is pluricanonical with a parallel Lee form and a non-integrable almost complex structure. The fundamental forms upstairs and downstairs are Laplacian eigenforms with an explicit eigenvalue ratio. Conversely, for a fixed normalized $SU(3)$ completion, we characterize the curvature of a circle-invariant locally conformal parallel lift. The lift equations force a pluricanonical base to have parallel Lee form, even locally, and exclude strict integrable pluricanonical bases. Independently, the pluricanonical eigenform identity gives a shrinking solution of He's full Hodge equation and an immortal $d^*d$ solution contracting the Lee plane.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 局部共形结构的圆商与显式Hodge流
analysis.workSummary: 设紧七维流形具局部共形平行G₂结构和非零平行Lee形式。若自由圆作用保持结构、轨道等长且正交于Lee场，则六维商具有pluricanonical局部共形几乎Kähler结构、平行Lee形式及不可积几乎复结构，上下基本形式为Hodge Laplacian本征形式并有显式本征值比。固定归一化SU(3)补全时，作者刻画圆不变局部共形平行提升的曲率。提升方程迫使pluricanonical底流形的Lee形式局部平行并排除严格可积底空间。
analysis.breakthrough: 从本征形式恒等式得到缩小的全Hodge流解，以及收缩Lee平面、正向长时存在的d*d流解。
analysis.limitations: 商结果要求保持结构的自由等长轨道圆作用及Lee正交性。提升判据固定归一化SU(3)补全。具体本征值和流时间参数见正文。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第3页作者披露ChatGPT 6.1 Sol检查常规计算并改善文章表述，记录verification及writing。作者说明数学思想、证明路线与结果由作者完成，致谢中使用的直接第一类LCS构造建议来自Tedi Drăghici。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.22931v1 · PDF第3页Declaration of AI assistance，全文11页。

analysis.priorityReason: 将特殊几何结构的商与提升刚性联系到显式几何流。
